scope: Source identity, not physical or gate qualification
difference: Only new optimization parameter defaults differ: production0, isolated candidate1
timing: E_LOOK owner snapshot reused on E_HIT. Mismatched owner epoch suppresses only an unformed hint. Data response is never retried or delayed.
notice_visibility: Existing STAT_DROP still counts formed notices lost to a busy buffer; it does not measure intentionally unformed stale-owner hints. Zero STAT_DROP must not be interpreted as proof that no stale hint was suppressed.
